sources.caveats: Hold-to-confirm only; there is no countdown. Releasing before the hold completes shows a hint for 2 s. A keyboard-triggered suspend or hibernate is committed once the hold completes, then runs on key release (or after the 5 s fallback), so the key release does not wake the machine. The logic is local to the component, so a new menu must copy it or embed PowerMenuContent. executeAction() emits closeRequested before it acts. Copy P5HomeDash's dgopRefHeld/syncDgopRef guard and hold refs only while the menu is visible, releasing them in Component.onDestruction.

overlayPattern:
Existing pattern, in /home/lyfmt/Projects/my-arch-kit/dms-p5/overlay/Modules/P5 (work/shell/Modules/P5 is byte-identical):

P5Apps.qml is a `pragma Singleton`, auto-registered as qs.Modules.P5 (there is no qmldir anywhere under overlay). It holds `LazyLoader { id: loader; active: false; P5AppsWindow {} }`. `_run(fn)` calls fn(loader.item) when the item exists. Otherwise it stores `_pending = fn` and sets `loader.active = true`, and onItemChanged replays _pending with Qt.callLater. API: `readonly property bool isOpen: loader.item?.shouldShow ?? false`, open(query), close() (calls loader.item?.close()) and toggle(). The loader is never deactivated, so after first use the window stays instantiated but hidden.

P5AppsWindow.qml is a `PanelWindow { visible: false; color: 'transparent'; WlrLayershell.namespace: 'dms:p5-apps'; WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay; WlrLayershell.exclusiveZone: -1; WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: shouldShow ? WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive : WlrKeyboardFocus.None; anchors top/bottom/left/right }`.
- open(query): picks `CompositorService.getFocusedScreen() ?? Quickshell.screens[0]` and assigns `screen` if it differs, sets shouldShow = true and visible = true, resets the Controller (searchMode 'apps', pluginFilter '', searchQuery ''), sets carousel.opened = true and its query, calls performSearch(), then carousel.forceActiveFocus().
- close(): sets shouldShow = false, which releases keyboard focus at once so a launched app gets it, and sets carousel.opened = false. The carousel's folded signal sets visible = false after the exit animation.

Proposed P3 menu: /home/lyfmt/Projects/my-arch-kit/dms-p5/overlay/Modules/P5/P3Menu.qml, using the same singleton, LazyLoader and _pending scheme with isOpen/open/close/toggle, plus P3MenuWindow.qml with:
- a full-screen PanelWindow, namespace 'dms:p3-menu', on the Overlay layer. That layer covers the Top-layer island and satellites. The island moves to Overlay only with DMS_DANKISLAND_LAYER or islandUseOverlayLayer (DankIslandHostWindow.qml:61-62), which is currently off.
- exclusiveZone -1 and all four anchors
- the focused screen chosen on open
- Exclusive keyboard focus only while shouldShow is true
- Escape and a backdrop click close the menu
- visible = false only after the exit animation
- DgopService refs (cpu, memory, system, diskmounts, network as needed; GPU via addGpuPciId) and one WeatherService ref, held only while shown, using P5HomeDash-style guards that release in Component.onDestruction
- the menu closes before it launches an app or runs a power action
- a copy of the PowerMenuContent hold-to-confirm and commit-on-key-release logic

- reused shared widgets from overlay/DankCommon/Widgets, imported as qs.DankCommon.Widgets (P5Plate, P5Meter, P5Tag, P5Ransom, P5Select, P5Switch, P5ActionChip, ...), and tokens from overlay/DankCommon/Common/P5.qml. The P3 watery look may need its own tokens.

Proposal: add a new handler in the same patch.
```qml
IpcHandler {
    target: "p3menu"
    function open(): string { P3Menu.open(); return "P3MENU_OPEN_SUCCESS"; }
    function close(): string { P3Menu.close(); return "P3MENU_CLOSE_SUCCESS"; }
    function toggle(): string { P3Menu.toggle(); return "P3MENU_TOGGLE_SUCCESS"; }
    function status(): string { return P3Menu.isOpen ? "open" : "closed"; }
}
```
It is called as `dms ipc call p3menu toggle`.
